benchmark: application-speed Phase G bounded warm-cache resource diagnostic

method.purpose: bounded resource/cache diagnosis only; not a replacement for the formal six-load acceptance matrix

finding.imageCacheBehavior: Most images were transfer-zero cache hits, but first-use image completion and decode duration varied substantially on TV Shows, Discover, and the movie detail.
finding.dashboardBehavior: The Dashboard also varied in document load while its image completion changed only modestly, so image decoding is not the sole cause of the four-route population comparison.
finding.conclusion: No safe application-side change is supported by this bounded diagnostic. Keep the formal warm-cache consistency exception explicit; a strict closure would require a controlled fresh-profile benchmark or a revised consistency protocol.
